title: Reading Section A 选词填空
paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 03

短文：
Every year the world produces far more clothes than people can wear. Prices are low, designs change quickly, and a T-shirt may be worn a few times before it is {{1}} away. The results are easy to see: mountains of clothing in landfills and rivers polluted by the dyes used in factories. Some companies have begun to {{2}} the problem by collecting old clothes in their shops, but only a small share of what is collected is turned into new fabric. Most is sold to other countries or burned. Consumers have more {{3}} than they realise. Washing clothes at a lower temperature and drying them in the air can {{4}} their life by years, and simple repairs can save a favourite jacket from the bin. Buying {{5}}, well-made clothes costs more at first but saves money later. Campaigners also encourage people to organise swap events, where friends bring clothes they no longer wear and take home something {{6}}. None of these actions is {{7}} on its own, but together they {{8}} the pressure on the planet. The most {{9}} change, campaigners argue, is to buy less and choose {{10}}.

blanks.explain: 选 M. thrown。be thrown away 意为“被扔掉”，与上衣只穿几次就被丢弃的语境一致，空格需过去分词构成被动。
选 L. tackle。tackle the problem 意为“应对、处理问题”，与 by collecting old clothes 的方式说明相搭配。
选 H. power。have more power than they realise 意为“拥有比自己意识到的更大的影响力”，指消费者可以通过选择影响环境。
选 F. extend。extend 意为“延长”，extend the life of clothes by years 即“把衣服的寿命延长数年”。
选 B. durable。durable 意为“耐穿的、结实的”，与 well-made 并列修饰 clothes；虽然初期花费更高，但此后更省钱。
选 A. different。something different 意为“不一样的东西”，说明交换活动让旧衣换成别的衣物，减少购买。
选 D. enough。none of these actions is enough on its own 意为“单靠其中任何一项都不够”，与 but 后的 together 形成对比。
选 J. reduce。reduce the pressure on the planet 意为“减轻对地球的压力”，是常见的动宾搭配。
选 C. effective。the most effective change 意为“最有效的改变”，形容词最高级修饰 change，表示倡导者认为最管用的做法。
选 N. wisely。choose wisely 意为“明智地选择”，需要副词修饰动词 choose，与 buy less 并列说明消费态度。
